block.smartsorting.pipe.tooltip.0: Connects to neighbouring pipes by itself.
block.smartsorting.pipe.tooltip.1: Pipes can branch; items find their own way.
block.smartsorting.pipe.tooltip.2: Holds up to 4 items in a line.
block.smartsorting.chest_exporter.toolti: Place on a chest: pulls items out into pipes.
block.smartsorting.chest_importer.toolti: Place on a chest: puts items from pipes into it.
Right-click: filter and priority. Empty list = accepts nothing.
block.smartsorting.chest_link.tooltip.0: Joins chests on its connected sides into one storage.
block.smartsorting.chest_link.tooltip.1: Right-click: choose sides. Open a linked chest to see every item.
block.smartsorting.chest_mover.tooltip.0: Moves items from its take chests into its give chests.
smartsorting.jei.chest_link: Place it next to chests: the sides facing chests connect by themselves. Right-click it to switch sides on or off. Two links connect when both have the sides facing each other switched on; links sharing a chest form one storage too. Right-click a linked chest to see the items of every linked chest at the top, with a scrollbar and a search box. Sneak + right-click a chest to open only that chest.
Exporter moves 4x more items per transfer.
smartsorting.status.stuck: Items stuck in pipe: no room
smartsorting.gui.tab.mod.tip: Filter by the mod an item comes from
smartsorting.gui.tab.items.tip: Filter by a list of items
smartsorting.gui.clear_items.tip: Remove every item from the list
smartsorting.gui.meta.tip: Damaged only matches damaged, unused only matches unused
smartsorting.gui.ore.tip: Match any item sharing a specific forge: tag (e.g. forge:gems/diamond)
smartsorting.gui.use.tip: Use this tab's filter (only one filter is active)
smartsorting.gui.empty_filter.tip: §7An empty list accepts nothing (or everything on Blacklist)
smartsorting.gui.importing_on.tip: Importing. Click to stop all items coming in
smartsorting.gui.importing_off.tip: Stopped: no items come in. Click to start importing
smartsorting.gui.importer_priority.tip: Higher priority importers are filled first
smartsorting.gui.ghost.tip.0: Click with an item to add it
smartsorting.gui.redstone.tip: When the exporter is allowed to run
smartsorting.jei.pipe: Pipes connect to each other automatically and may branch. They also join exporters and importers on any side except the chest side.
smartsorting.jei.chest_exporter: Place it on a chest (or any inventory). It pulls items out and sends each item to the best destination it can reach. Right-click for redstone control, delivery order and upgrade slots.
smartsorting.jei.chest_importer: Place it on a chest. Items arriving through the pipes are put into that chest. Give it a filter (by mod or by a list of items) to choose what it takes; with an empty list it takes nothing (or everything on Blacklist). The On/Off button stops it taking anything. Importers with a higher priority are filled first; when one is full or refuses an item, it goes to the next.
smartsorting.jei.wrench: Right-click to rotate exporters and importers. Sneak + right-click to pick up any block from this mod with its contents.
smartsorting.jei.upgrades: Put these in an exporter. Items travel at 0.75 blocks per second; a speed upgrade makes it 2, a transit upgrade 4, both 8. Exporters send as often as the pipe allows, always 4 items per pipe, so faster travel also means more items per second. Stack upgrades send 4 items at a time. One of each per exporter.
